name: mission-control
description: Self-hosted AI agent orchestration platform: dispatch tasks, run multi-agent workflows, monitor spend, and govern operations from one mission control dashboard.
summary: 自托管 AI 代理编排平台：从单一指挥仪表盘出发，调度任务、运行多代理工作流、监控支出并管理运营
categoryDescription: SQL、数据处理、统计、可视化与商业分析
howToUse: 阅读仓库 README 的安装要求，将 Skill、插件或工具接入对应环境，再按文档触发工作流。
installCommand:
git clone https://github.com/builderz-labs/mission-control.git
cd mission-control
bash install.sh --local     # or: bash install.sh --docker
